fact: At a ceremony the Interior Ministry and police handed production of Comoros' passports and biometric cards from Semlex to GenKey, with the minister saying Comoros will for the first time control its biometric data.
title: Revue de la Cérémonie officielle de passation – Production des passeports et cartes biométriques
publisher: Direction Générale de la Police et de la Sûreté Nationale (DGPSN)
